title: Stewed Earthy Delight
description: A hearty, earthy stew made with a blend of Japanese flavors, perfect for a cold day. Earthy mushrooms are slow-cooked with a variety of vegetables and spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the diced sweet potatoes, sliced celery, and grated ginger. Cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the soy sauce and sushi rice vinegar. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions.
